def f(t):
    h,w=len(t),len(t[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in t for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if t[i][j]!=bg]
    s=set(pts)
    def is_between(p):
        r,c=p
        up=any(q[0]<r and q[1]==c for q in s)
        dn=any(q[0]>r and q[1]==c for q in s)
        lf=any(q[0]==r and q[1]<c for q in s)
        rt=any(q[0]==r and q[1]>c for q in s)
        return (up and dn) or (lf and rt)
    rmin=min(i for i,j in s); rmax=max(i for i,j in s)
    cmin=min(j for i,j in s); cmax=max(j for i,j in s)
    out=[r[:] for r in t]
    for i in range(rmin,rmax+1):
        for j in (cmin,cmax):
            if out[i][j]==bg or is_between((i,j)): out[i][j]=2
    for j in range(cmin,cmax+1):
        for i in (rmin,rmax):
            if out[i][j]==bg or is_between((i,j)): out[i][j]=2
    return out
allok=True
for k in range(1,9):

    allok = allok and len(bad)==0
    print(k,'OK' if not bad else 'MISMATCH n=%d'%len(bad),bad[:5])
print('ALL',allok)

def f(t):
    h,w=len(t),len(t[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in t for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    s={(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if t[i][j]!=bg}
    out=[r[:] for r in t]
    for (r1,c1),(r2,c2) in __import__('itertools').combinations(sorted(s),2):
        a,b,d_,e=min(r1,r2),min(c1,c2),max(r1,r2),max(c1,c2)
        if a==b or b==e: continue
        corners=[(a,b),(a,e),(d_,b),(d_,e)]
        n=sum(p in s for p in corners)
        if n<3: continue
        # paint perimeter bg cells, but skip the (at most one) implied corner
        impl = [p for p in corners if p not in s]
        for p in corners:
            if p in s or p==impl[0]: continue
            ii,jj=p
            if out[ii][jj]==bg: out[ii][jj]=2
    return out
